conditional_minus_portal_charge_and_supp.charge_channel_rule: unordered pair of ORIGINAL scalar component charges; includes interference
conditional_minus_portal_charge_and_supp.reconstruction_relative_error_denominato: max(coherent norm, 1e-12 * sum individual term norms) to cover exact-zero cancellation
conditional_minus_portal_charge_and_supp.suppression_definition: Frobenius norm below 0.01 times partition maximum; never discarded
conditional_minus_portal_charge_and_supp.warning: Degenerate Takagi eigenvectors, individual terms and MSbar channel pieces depend on basis/scheme; only the full sum is invariant.
